item.title: Match Report: Walsall 0-1 Fleetwood Town
item.description: Walsall suffered a frustrating 1-0 loss to Fleetwood Town at the Pallet-Track Bescot Stadium on Tuesday night. Mark Helm’s early first half strike was the difference in the Black Country and condemned the Saddlers to defeat in League Two. Head Coach Mat Sadler named an unchanged starting line-up from the Saddlers’ 2-1 win over Shrewsbury Town on Saturday, although Aaron Loupalo-Bi and Kacper Lopata did replace Harrison Burke and Connor Barrett on the bench. item.title: Mat Sadler shares his frustration with Fleetwood defeat
item.description: Head Coach Mat Sadler was left frustrated with the nature of last night's defeat to Fleetwood as a first half goal for the Cod Army saw the Saddlers condemned to six without a win on home soil. Sadler was pleased with the performance of the squad but explained how things needed to improve in the final third. "Difficult one to take because we didn't deserve to lose," Sadler said. item.title: Turner reflects on first league defeat of the season
item.description: Walsall Women midfielder Lottie Turner admitted that the Saddlers’ 2-0 loss to Lichfield City Women on Sunday afternoon was a real game of two halves. Despite Walsall’s spirited performance at the Tyre Trading Community Stadium, second half goals from Courtney Dilger and Skye Wright condemned them to a defeat in the West Midlands Regional Women’s Football League Division One North. item.title: Harper expresses frustration following narrow defeat
item.description: Walsall defender Vincent Harper expressed his frustration following the Saddlers’ 1-0 loss to Fleetwood Town on Tuesday night at the Pallet-Track Bescot Stadium. Mark Helm’s strike after 16 minutes was the difference maker in the contest, despite Walsall dominating proceedings on home soil. item.title: Harrison Burke & Aaron Pressley visit Blue Coat C.E. Academy with Walsall FC Foundation
item.description: Students at Blue Coat C.E. Academy were delighted to welcome Saddlers players Harrison Burke and Aaron Pressley last week.
